chunks: There is no constraint on the Prophet in what God has decreed for him. This has been the way of God with (apostles) who have gone before you, and God's command is a determined act.

key_terms.سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ: the way or practice of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there was no constraint on the Prophet regarding what God decreed for him?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in the context of the Prophet's marriage to Zaynab bint Jahsh, clarifies that he was not bound by the customary social restrictions regarding the wives of adopted sons, thereby establishing a divine precedent (Sunnah) for all prophets. It underscores the concept of Qadar (divine decree), affirming that God's commands are absolute and executed without hindrance, a principle particularly emphasized in Shia exegesis to highlight the Prophet's unique authority in implementing divine law.
